facts.text: Vila Vita Parc is a five-star resort and a member of The Leading Hotels of the World, in a seaside setting in the Algarve.
facts.excerpt: Five-star resort and member of “The Leading Hotels of the World”, heralded for our timeless elegance and style

facts.text: The resort is reminiscent of a traditional Portuguese village, with cobblestone pathways, flower-filled gardens and waterways.
facts.excerpt: reminiscent of a traditional Portuguese village, with cobblestone pathways, flower-filled gardens and waterways

facts.text: Rooms and suites sit above the cliff top in several distinct buildings, each with its own character and architecture, surrounded by a park landscape.
facts.excerpt: Perched above the cliff top and located in various distinct buildings, each having its own character and architecture

facts.text: The resort villas have outdoor areas with infinity pools, spacious gardens and ocean-view terraces.
facts.excerpt: outdoor areas with infinity pools, spacious gardens and ocean-view terraces

facts.text: The resort villas are aimed at groups of friends or families holidaying together.
facts.excerpt: promise seclusion and comfort for groups of friends or families holidaying together

facts.text: The Vista Parc Apartments are next to the resort, and their guests can use all the resort's services and facilities.
facts.excerpt: The stylish Vista Parc Apartments are conveniently located next to the resort, welcoming our guests to make full use of all Vila Vita Parc Resort & Spa services and facilities.

facts.text: The Vila Vita Collection is a set of luxury serviced villas and beachfront residences in the Algarve, outside the resort, owned and managed by Vila Vita Parc.
facts.excerpt: The Vila Vita Collection comprises luxury serviced villas and beachfront residences in the Algarve, all owned and managed by Vila Vita Parc.

facts.text: Through Our Finest Tables is a guided evening through the resort's fine dining restaurants, with curated pairings and a dedicated host.
facts.excerpt: Through Our Finest Tables is an intimate, guided immersion through our fine dining restaurants - with carefully curated pairings and a dedicated host

facts.text: The Vila Vita Biergarten serves German and artisanal beers, including Porches Craft Beer.
facts.excerpt: designed to complement our curated range of German and artisanal beers, including the ever-popular Porches Craft Beer

facts.text: The resort has boutiques in the Piazetta.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a festive shopping extravaganza at the stylish boutiques in the Piazetta

facts.text: The spa occupies its own dedicated building, and its treatment menu was created in partnership with Sisley.
facts.excerpt: the spa at Vila Vita Parc, which occupies its own, dedicated building and whose treatment menu was created in partnership with French spa leader Sisley

facts.text: The spa offers medical-grade pedicures from podiatrist Margaret Dabbs.
facts.excerpt: medical-grade pedi-cures (get it?) from legendary podiatrist Margaret Dabbs

facts.text: The spa has a garden yoga pavilion for private, group and aerial classes.
facts.excerpt: it has a garden yoga pavilion for private, group, and aerial classes

facts.text: Personal trainers are on hand for custom workouts and the HYPOXI Method.
facts.excerpt: there are personal trainers on hand for custom workouts and deep dives into the HYPOXI Method

facts.text: The resort's address is Rua Anneliese Pohl, Alporchinhos, Porches.
Vila Vita Parc appeared in Conde Nast Traveler's Readers' Choice Awards in 2026.
The resort's wellness approach places equal emphasis on body, soul and mind with nutrition, mindfulness and exercise plans.
facts.excerpt: Our holistic approach to wellness, place equal emphasis on body, soul and mind with nutrition, mindfulness and exercise plans.

facts.text: The resort describes an unsurpassed range of services and ultra-luxurious facilities.
facts.excerpt: unsurpassed range of services and amenities, ultra-luxurious facilities
